newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Up to eight Oman, three Tapis offered to Bangchak.
newsitem.headline: Up to eight Oman, three Tapis offered to Bangchak.

text.p: Up to eight cargoes of Oman crude oil and three cargoes of Tapis have been offered into the Bangchak Petroleum Plc tender to buy December crudes, industry sources said on Thursday.
Bangchak tendered to buy 500,000 barrels of Gulf grades and 600,000 barrels of Far East light sweet crude oil for its 120,000 barrels-per-day refinery.
The tender closed on Wednesday and offers are valid until 1800 hours Bangkok time (1100 GMT) later on Thursday.
But the industry sources said up to eight Oman cargoes have been put on offer at prices ranging from MPM plus six cents to MPM plus 12 cents per barrel.
Reported Oman spot deals for December have mostly been trading in recent days between MPM plus seven cents and plus 10 cents.
The sources said three cargoes of Tapis crude oil have also been offered.
Two December loading cargos were offered by traders at premiums over benchmark quotes of between $1.50 and $1.60 per barrel, the sources said.
A late November loading cargo was also offered at a premium around $1.40, the sources said.
Bangchak awarded a cargo of Oman crude at MPM flat and a cargo of Tapis crude at quotes plus $1.15 in negotiations after its November tender.
